check_index_size.query: SELECT schemaname, relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_table_size(relid)) AS table_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(relid)) AS index_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC

total_connections.desc: Total Number of Connections or running backends

PG_Active_Connections.query: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active'

count_connection_idle.query: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state ='idle'

connections_waiting_in_locks.query: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event = 'Lock'
connections_waiting_in_locks.desc: Number of connections/backends waiting on locks

connections_idle_in_transaction.query: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event = 'idle in transaction'
connections_idle_in_transaction.desc: Number of backends in an idle transaction

database_state.query: SELECT state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = '{{DBNAME}}'

number_users.desc: Number of users connected in PostgreSQL

number_commits.query: SELECT sum(xact_commit) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'
number_commits.desc: Number of commits in current transaction for {{DBNAME}}

number_rollbacks.query: SELECT sum(xact_rollback) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'

tuples_returned.query: SELECT sum(tup_returned) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'
tuples_returned.desc: Number of rows returned by queries in {{DBNAME}}

tuples_searched.query: SELECT sum(tup_fetched) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'

tuples_inserted.query: SELECT sum(tup_inserted) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'

tuples_updated.query: SELECT sum(tup_updated) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'

tuples_removed.query: SELECT sum(tup_deleted) FROM (pg_database AS db JOIN pg_stat_database sdb ON db.datname=sdb.datname) WHERE db.datname = '{{DBNAME}}'
